mapper.select: /* BmsMobPasmMapper.selectTakeOutSample : 견품반출 - 박스 번호 조회 */ SELECT 'WORK' AS DATA , P.PACKING_NO, P.SAMPLE_OUT_CT, I.BL_NO, S.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, S.PERMISSION_NO, S.SAMPLE_EMPLOYEE_NAME, S.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, S.SAMPLE_PIECES, S.OD_JOB_NO, S.RETURN_DATE, S.CARRYOUT_TIME FROM TB_BMS_SAMPLE S INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) ON S.IN_NO = I.IN_NO AND I.IN_PLAN_NO > 0 INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG P WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE P.PACKING_NO = #{srchNo}
